Here’s a classic ingredient list for a traditional meat‑based lasagna:

**For the Béchamel Sauce (White Sauce)**
- Butter – 2 Tbsp
- All‑purpose flour – 2 Tbsp
- Whole milk – 2 cups (warm)
- Salt – pinch
- White pepper – pinch
- Nutmeg – pinch (optional)

**For the Meat Ragù (Meat Sauce)**
- Olive oil – 1 Tbsp
- Onion – 1 small, finely chopped
- Carrot – 1 small, finely diced
- Celery stalk – 1, finely diced
- Garlic cloves – 2, minced
- Ground beef or pork (or a mix) – 500 g (about 1 lb)
- Tomato paste – 2 Tbsp
- Crushed tomatoes or passata – 400 g (about 14 oz)
- Red wine – ½ cup (optional)
- Bay leaf – 1
- Dried oregano – ½ tsp
- Salt & black pepper – to taste

**Other Components**
- Lasagna sheets – 9–12 sheets (no‑boil or regular, depending on preference)
- Shredded mozzarella cheese – 250 g (about 8 oz)
- Grated Parmesan cheese – 100 g (about ⅓ cup)
- Fresh basil leaves – handful (optional, for garnish)

**Optional Add‑ons**
- Ricotta cheese – 200 g (for layering)
- Spinach or other leafy greens – 150 g (sautéed, optional)
- Egg – 1 (if mixing into ricotta for extra richness)

These ingredients will give you a hearty, flavorful lasagna that can be baked at 180 °C (350 °F) for about 35–45 minutes until bubbly and golden. Enjoy!
